findings.source_en: Usually, I would simply execute him.
findings.issue: 'Usually, I would simply execute him' is habitual ('normally I just execute them, but…' — it sets up 09_20 'But perhaps you see another way?'). كنتُ لأُعدمه is the counterfactual 'I would have executed him', the same construction used for a genuine counterfactual at Interact_13_20 ('I’d do it all over again', which is governed by 'If I could…'). Here there is no protasis, so the counterfactual reading implies the execution is already off the table before Egon offers Lazlo the choice.
